name: Omaland Themepark
author: Kevin Goff
description: A picker of curated looks for Hyprland windows, with live preview and a full option editor behind Tab. Writes a managed block into ~/.config/hypr/looknfeel.lua. Open from SUPER+SPACE by searching 'Omaland Themepark' or from the terminal with: omarchy-shell shell toggle gumbledore.omaland-themepark
